# Using Tripo to Generate Unit Models

Tripo is an online AI tool that can generate 3D models from a single image or text description.

<!-- We first need to follow the process below to export the model generated by Tripo; then upload it to Mixamo for auto-rigging; and finally upload it in the Unit Model Editor. -->
We first generate and export the model in Tripo; then upload it to Mixamo for automatic rigging and export; and finally upload it in the Unit Mod Editor.

<!-- We need to perform the operation twice, generating LOD1 and LOD2 models respectively, and upload them in the Unit Model Editor. Both models represent the same character, but the LOD1 model has more details (higher poly count, larger texture size). -->
We need to generate the LOD1 and LOD2 models separately and upload them in the Unit Mod Editor. Both represent the same character, but the LOD1 model has more details (higher poly count, higher texture resolution).

<!-- Note: The following operations require a VPN. You can purchase a low-cost VPN [here](https://dash.pqjc.site/dashboard). -->

# Workflow for Generating the LOD1 Model

## 1. Generate and Export the Model

The key points here are to ensure a poly count of around 15,000, use a T-pose, do not use HD texture or PBR, and use 1k texture resolution on export.

We first introduce using the Tripo Lite version to generate models. Its advantage is that it generates 4 models at once (thus consuming fewer credits per model) and allows "negative prompts" to ensure more accurate models; its disadvantage is that it only allows text prompts (image-to-model is not recommended here).

- [Click me](https://www.tripo3d.ai/app/home) to enter Tripo, click "Enter Tripo Lite Version"
- Click the top right corner to register and log in
    <!-- - Use the first login method (email verification code) -->
    - After first login, you should have 300 free credits. You can click the "+" in the top right -> Upgrade
- [Click me](https://www.tripo3d.ai/app/home) to back
- Do not check "HD texture"
- Click "Settings"
    - Do not check "PBR"
    - Mesh Resolution select "Standard"
    - Face limit to around 15000
    - Enter Negative Prompt:
A-pose, asymmetrical, slouching, leaning, bent pose, walking pose, feet together, legs crossed, close up, cropped
    - Model Scale -> LegSpread drag to max (to spread the legs apart for easier rigging)
    - Select "T-pose"
- Enter text description in the prompt (e.g., "anime girl")
- Click "Generate"
- Four models will be generated. Click on a suitable model (ensure correct T-pose); or in "My Models" click on a suitable model
- Click on the left "Refine in Tripo Studio"
- Click on the bottom left "Edit in Workspace" to enter Studio
- Click on the bottom right "Export"
    - Format select "FBX" -> Mixamo
    - Texture resolution select "1k"
    - Do not check "Bottom Center Pivot"
    - Click "Export", a zip file will be downloaded

Next, we introduce using the Tripo International Studio to generate models. Its advantage is that it allows image-based model generation and further editing; its disadvantage is higher credit consumption.

- [Click me](https://studio.tripo3d.ai/workspace/generate) to enter Studio -> Models
- Click the top right corner to register and log in
- Click on the left "Generate Model" -> "Smart Mesh"
- You can generate models via text or image
    - Text-to-model:
        - Click the fourth icon: TODOtu
        - Enter description (e.g., "anime girl")
        - Click "T-pose"
        <!-- - Click Generation Settings -> More, Topology select "Triangle Mesh", Poly count select around 15000, not check "4K texture" and "PBR" -->
        - Click Generation Settings -> More, Topology select "Triangle Mesh", Poly count select around 15000
        - Click "Generate Model"
        - After generation, if unsatisfied, you can click "Free Retry" below to regenerate
        - Click "Texture Generation" below
        - Do not check "HD texture"
        - Click "Generate Texture"
        - Click on the bottom right "Export", steps are the same as before
    - Image-to-model:
        - Click the first icon: TODOtu
        - Upload an image (needs to be T-pose)
            - Reference image:
            TODO tu
            - If not in T-pose, you can convert it to a T-pose image in the left sidebar under ["Image"](https://studio.tripo3d.ai/workspace/generate-image), specific steps:
            1. Click "More Templates" -> T-pose
            2. Click the image button TODOtu, upload the image to be converted
            3. Click Generate Image, you should get a T-pose converted image
        - You can click TODOtu to edit the image
        - Click "Generate Multi-Views" to generate multi-view images, which will result in a more accurate model
        - Click Generation Settings -> More, Topology select "Triangle", Polycount select around 15000
        - Click "Generate Model"
        - Afterwards, similar steps as above

## 2. Upload to Mixamo for Rigging

Because we are using Mixamo animations, and Tripo's auto-rigging (in the Animation tab) is not compatible with Mixamo, we need to auto-rig in Mixamo.

Steps:

- Unzip the previously downloaded model zip file to obtain an FBX file
- [Click me](https://www.mixamo.com/#/) to enter Mixamo
- Click the top right corner to register and log in
- Click on the right "UPLOAD CHARACTER" and upload the FBX file
- Click "NEXT" on the bottom right
- Place markers
    - Refer to the reference image on the right, drag markers to the specified positions
    - If the model is asymmetric, you can uncheck "Use Symmetry" below, then you can drag asymmetric markers to the positions
    - Click "NEXT" to continue
    - If it fails (e.g., due to asymmetry), you need to regenerate the model in Tripo and try again
- Click "DOWNLOAD" on the right -> "DOWNLOAD" to download the rigged model

## 3. Upload the Model in the Unit Model Editor

- In the editor, under "Model", click "Upload LOD1 Model" and upload the previously downloaded model

# Workflow for Generating the LOD2 Model

The key points here are to ensure a poly count of around 5,000 and use 512 texture resolution on export.

## 1. Retopologize in Studio to Reduce Poly Count

- In Studio, click "Retopo" in the left sidebar
- Topology Select "Triangle"
- Set polygon count to around 5000
- Click "Export" on the bottom right, steps are the same as before, but set texture resolution to 512

## 2. Upload to Mixamo for Rigging

Same steps as before

## 3. Upload the Model in the Unit Model Editor

- In the editor, under "Model", click "Upload LOD2 Model" (this button becomes visible only after uploading LOD1 model), and upload the previously downloaded model

# Workflow for Uploading Model Thumbnail

## 1. Obtain Model Thumbnail

Studio:

- Locate the model in the "Assets" on the right
- Right-click the model -> Save image as -> Save as type select "All files", add ".png" to the file name

Lite:

- Locate the model in "My Models"
- Right-click the model -> Save image as -> add ".png" to the file name

## 2. Upload Thumbnail in the Unit Model Editor

- In the editor, under "Model", click "Upload Model Thumbnail" (this button becomes visible only after uploading both LOD1 and LOD2 models), and upload the thumbnail
